payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a futuristic HUD (Heads Up Display) or FUI. Use: thin lines (1px), neon cyan/blue on black, technical markers, decorative brackets, data visualization, monospaced tech fonts, glowing elements, transparency.
payload.best_for: Sci-fi games, space tech, cybersecurity, movie props, immersive dashboards
payload.css_technical_keywords: border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.5), color: #00FFFF, background: transparent or rgba(0,0,0,0.8), font-family: monospace, text-shadow: 0 0 5px cyan
payload.do_not_use_for: Standard corporate, reading heavy content, accessible public services
payload.effects_and_animation: Glow effects, scanning animations, ticker text, blinking markers, fine line drawing
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Fine lines 1px, ☐ Neon glow text/borders, ☐ Monospaced font, ☐ Dark/Transparent BG, ☐ Decorative tech markers, ☐ Holographic feel
payload.keywords: Futuristic, technical, wireframe, neon, data, transparency, iron man, sci-fi, interface
payload.primary_colors: Neon Cyan #00FFFF, Holographic Blue #0080FF, Alert Red #FF0000
